reason: A local-first A-share investment research workbench centered on market data, valuation analysis, agent-generated reports, dashboards, and persistent follow-up research conversations.

summaries.zh: 面向 A 股研究的本地优先工作台，提供行情看板、自选股、估值分析、智能体研判、版本化报告和后续对话。
summaries.en: A local-first A-share research workbench for market dashboards, watchlists, valuation analysis, agent-generated reports, and persistent follow-up conversations.

capabilities: Retrieves market and valuation data from external providers

Stores watchlists, report snapshots, and research data locally
Provides interactive dashboards, charts, valuation views, and follow-up chat
